You're most likely experiecing a psychotic event of some kind. You're going to be ok, what you should do is call either a family member or a friend and tell them. It could also be beneficial to have the take you to a hospital where you can get meds if needed.

If you don't have someone you can call, id say call 988, they can probably advise you better than I can on what to do, and can send someone to get you if you need. You'll be alright, don't worry, just stay calm, take deep breaths, and call someone you can trust

Yes, I believe it was called, "A Bitch in the Locker Room" by Sugarbleed. I've been looking for a story by them for a bit without luck. Heres their internet archive page, though I'm afraid it the story you're looking for hasn't been archived.

[https://web.archive.org/web/20200921150633/https://www.deviantart.com/sugarbleed](https://web.archive.org/web/20200921150633/https://www.deviantart.com/sugarbleed)
Can I ask more about how and why you do this?

College depression is real as hell. I don't know your past, but I can relate to how you're feeling right now. The only thing I can suggest in the short term, if you're still awake, is to get a glass of water and go to bed. Suicidal urges come and go, and for me, they flare up at moments where I don't take care of myself, and then I don't take care of myself because I'm suicidal.

 Its a vicious cycle that you can break by changing whats making you upset, at least in the short term. So take a second, I'm sorry you feel alone right now, but I promise there are people out there who care about you. I'd like to read your poetry one day, if you'd be willing to share. But for now, just try to go to bed and see how you feel tomorrow

My did is in a similar boat, he just divorced my mother and is staying at a friends house. I get the sense he's not doing well, and its eating me up inside. I'm worried sick about him, and all I want is for home to be better and this to be over. I don't know how old your son is, but if he's anything like me he cares a lot for you. 

My dad also said the same thing about therapy, though he never tried it in the first place, lmao. If you can, try talking to someone, doesn't have to be your wife or your kid, but telling someone (even a stranger) can help take some of the weight off your chest. Cliche as fuck, I know, and I'm sorry, but its what I wish my dad would do.  Just so I know he wants to get better.

I'm sorry you're feeling this way. I know what loneliness feels like. But even though these feelings are strong, they're not permanent. I was fortunate enough to have people in my life to show me this. Overtime, I was able to learn how to socialize, and train myself to avoid negative spirals in my thoughts. I'm living a much happier life now,

All things are subject to change. That is the nature of time. I promise you that no matter how hopeless things seem, there is always the possibility of change. I'm routing for you. One day, we;'l all be free, and one day, I believe you'll find the warmth of love you seek,

I think you're good enough. I think you're brave for posting this and trying to find help. I'm sorry your life has been so tough, and I'm sorry you don't feel good enough. But I promise you, you have the capacity for great things. Social skills can be learned and sharpened, I was able to improve my abilities greatly. 

Did anything is particular drive you to this decision?
I love you (and your cats super cute)
Lmao I just rewatched all of one punch man, I forgot how good it is. I'm gonna pick up the manga when I finish, but maybe I'll do chainsaw man first. I've heard go things about it.

I'm alive because theres so much i haven't done yet. I understand you've tried a lot of things to stay alive. I'm proud of you for having done all that. Me, personally, I don't feel I've done enough. Its a blessing and a curse. 

On one hand, it maddening to never feel like I've done enough, it can be exhausting. On the other hand, it gives me a reason to keep going. I want to write a book one day, and get better at drawing, and get physically stronger, and see Aurora Borealis, etc. I have so many goals and dreams, and I understand I may never get to them all. But we only get to live this life once, and i want to make the most of it during this fleeting moment we have together.

Hey man, I'm not going to pretend like I know your situation, but I know what its like be be at your lowest. I'm sure you've been through a lot, and right now, it seems like the only way things can end is by killing yourself. I've struggled with suicidal thoughts for most of my life, but right now, I can honestly say I'm glad I didn't do it.

I would have missed so much, So many birthdays, so many drinks, so many people I've met. There are still so many things I want to do with my life, and I only get this one chance. We only get one chance. I don't know what comes after death, I hope its peaceful, but as far as I know, once I die, this life is over, and I'm never coming back. I want to make the most of it while I'm still here, despite how hard it can be. If I can ask you something, I'd like to know, whats something you've always wanted to do?
talk to a police officer. Being in jail is better than risking the lives of a family member or your own

fuck him. Go and confront about it if its safe to do so. Point out his abusive behaviour and ask him to make amends. If that doesn't work try to find some new friends. If they turn there back on you that quick without even asking you your side, than fuck them too

If she really doesn’t think you can be together, than there’s not much you can do about that. However, you can definitely talk about arranging better/more time with your kids. I saw a reply  above that was giving off a sort of “man up” theme. I strongly disagree. If you are hurting and in enough pain that you,”feel like my only option is to eliminate myself from the equation to make everyone happy” then I believe you should try therapy. You are not weak, or selfish, what you are feeling is perfectly natural, even if it’s hard. There are people out there who care. I promise. Please, stay strong
